finding.detail: The new model clears request/task/isLoading and calls didFinish only if it both owns the request and isOwnerCurrent(). The production guard includes requireMounted -> surface.isForegroundMounted. Current db7b editor defines this using windowScene.activationState == foregroundActive; its explicit unmount covers actual removal/dismissal rather than transient inactivity. A request may settle while the same sheet/request remains owned but foreground eligibility is temporarily false, skipping cleanup and blocking a later same-sheet retry.
finding.limit: Source inference, not an observed simulator reproduction; no claim of cross-Space leakage.
finding.requestedCorrection: Separate same-request owned completion cleanup from current-authority-gated result/error publication. Preserve replacement-generation protection and existing drain. Cover transient owner guard false, no result/feedback publication, then retry when current again.
